## TemplateEngine.processImportBlocks() method

Recursively processes and resolves `<import>` blocks in a template.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static processImportBlocks(template: string, resolver: (src: string) => string | null, depth?: number, importCache?: Map<string, string>): string;
```

**Returns:**

string

Template with all `<import>` blocks resolved and replaced

## Remarks

This method resolves all `<import>` directives in a template by calling the provided resolver function to fetch external template content. It supports recursive imports with a depth limit of 10 to prevent infinite loops. An optional cache can be provided to avoid redundant resolutions.

## Example


```typescript
const template = '<import src="header" block="message" />\n<message>Main content</message>';
const resolver = (src: string) => {
  if (src === 'header') return '<message>Header text</message>';
  return null;
};
const result = TemplateEngine.processImportBlocks(template, resolver);
// Result: '<message>Header text</message>\n<message>Main content</message>'
```
